essence: The named mudrā is held to possess the power of universal subjugation.
The mudrā called Unmādinī has the power to attract all women.
The Mahāṅkuśā mudrā is capable of fulfilling all desires and aims.
The Khecarī mudrā is employed in connection with the earthly locus.
The Bīja-mudrā rapidly enhances all siddhis.
